幽暗的地底暗道，漆黑无光，只有壁间残存的阴煞微光隐约泛动。

七八名甲贺忍者呈扇形散开，脚步轻盈如猫，紧贴通道两侧壁面，缓缓朝着转角处逼近。

他们气息收敛到极致，周身萦绕淡淡的幻术黑雾，随时可以开启迷幻结界，隐匿身形、迷惑感知，是甲贺忍最擅长的潜行围杀打法。

为首的上忍眼神阴沉，死死盯着前方通道地面残留的阵法破碎痕迹，心底满是忌惮。

西风村外围阴阵布置多年，固若金汤，却被这群华夏修士轻易攻破，还追入地底暗道，足以见得对方实力强悍，绝非普通散修可比。

但暗道狭窄，地形受限，对方战力再强，也难以展开阵型。只要近身偷袭、幻术困敌，以多围少，未必不能就地斩杀。

转角阴影处，胡九郎与范梦雪静立不动，气息完全内敛，连呼吸都压到极轻。

“七个甲贺忍，一名上忍带队，其余皆是中忍，擅长幻术、潜行、近身毒刃。”范梦雪以传音入密轻声说道，“暗道空间狭小，雷法不宜大范围释放，容易震塌通道，只能近身配合符箓灭杀。”

胡九郎微微颔首，同样传音回应：“我封幻术、困走位，你以雷法定点镇压，速战速决，不要拖延，免得深处还有援兵赶来。”

二人默契达成，静待忍者入伏。

几名忍者一步步踏入转角视野范围，目光警惕扫视空旷通道，见无人踪影，稍稍放松警惕，以为对方已经顺着暗道深处逃走。

“分头追，堵住前后路口，绝不能让他们靠近腹地据点！”上忍低声下令，就要分出人手往前探查。

就在这一刻——

淡淡的金光骤然从地面升起，转瞬之间，一道简易八卦困阵悄然铺开，笼罩整片通道截面。

阵纹隐于地面，泛着微不可查的金芒，瞬间封锁八方走位。

踏入阵中的几名甲贺忍脸色骤变，只觉周身空气骤然凝滞，身形仿佛陷入粘稠泥潭，脚步沉重，遁术、幻术全都运转不畅。

“阵法！不好，有埋伏！”

上忍惊喝一声，立刻催动体内邪力，想要冲破阵法束缚，同时抬手结印，周身黑雾暴涨，就要开启大范围幻术迷惑对手。

“晚了。”

清冷声音从阴影中传出。

胡九郎缓步走出，黑衣身影立在阵法边缘，指尖夹着两枚朱砂符箓，随手一抛。

符箓凌空展开，化作两道赤色光纹，分别封住通道左右两侧壁面，硬生生隔断幻术黑雾蔓延，彻底锁死甲贺忍赖以依仗的遁术与迷心术。

幻术被封，潜行失效，一众忍者瞬间陷入正面硬拼的被动局面。

“出手！”

The dark underground passage was pitch black and lightless, with only the remaining evil light faintly flickering between the walls.

Seven or eight Koga ninjas spread out in a fan shape, walking as light as a cat, clinging to the walls on both sides of the passage, slowly approaching the corner.

Their auras have been condensed to the extreme, and there is a faint black mist of illusion lingering around them. They can open the psychedelic barrier at any time to hide their bodies and confuse their perceptions. This is the stealth and killing method that Koga Ninja is best at.

The leader's eyes were gloomy, staring at the broken traces of the formation on the ground in the passage ahead, filled with fear in his heart.

The Yin formation outside Xifeng Village has been set up for many years and is impregnable. However, it was easily broken through by this group of Chinese monks and they even chased them into the underground secret passage. This shows that the opponent is very powerful and cannot be compared with ordinary casual cultivators.

However, the secret passage is narrow and the terrain is restricted. No matter how powerful the opponent is, it will be difficult to form a formation.As long as you attack at close range, trap the enemy with illusions, and surround the enemy with more numbers, you may not be unable to kill them on the spot.

In the shadow of the corner, Hu Jiulang and Fan Mengxue stood still, their breaths completely restrained, even their breathing was very light.

"There are seven Koga nins, one jounin leads the team, and the rest are all chuunin, good at illusions, stealth, and close poison blades." Fan Mengxue said softly through voice transmission. "The space of the secret passage is small, and the thunder method is not suitable for large-scale release. It is easy to collapse the passage, so we can only close up and cooperate with the talisman to kill."

Hu Jiulang nodded slightly and responded with the same message: "I will seal the illusion and trap the enemy. You can suppress them with thunder and lightning. The battle will be quick. Don't delay, lest reinforcements arrive from deep."

The two reached a tacit understanding and waited for the ninja to ambush.

Several ninjas stepped into the corner of the field of vision step by step, scanning the empty passage with vigilant eyes. When they saw no one, they relaxed their vigilance slightly, thinking that the other party had escaped deep down the secret passage.

"Split up and chase, block the front and rear intersections, and never let them get close to the hinterland stronghold!" The jounin ordered in a low voice, and he was about to divide his manpower to explore forward.

At this moment——

A faint golden light suddenly rose from the ground, and in an instant, a simple Bagua trap quietly spread out, covering the entire passage section.

The formation pattern was hidden on the ground, glowing with an undetectable golden light, instantly blocking movement in all directions.

The expressions of the several Koga ninjas who stepped into the formation suddenly changed, and they felt that the air around them suddenly stagnated, their bodies seemed to be stuck in a viscous quagmire, their footsteps were heavy, and all their escape and illusion techniques were not functioning smoothly.

"Array! No, there's an ambush!"

The jounin shouted in surprise, and immediately activated the evil power in his body, trying to break through the constraints of the formation. At the same time, he raised his hand to form a seal, and the black mist around him skyrocketed, and he was about to activate a large-scale illusion to confuse the opponent.

"It's late."

A cool voice came from the shadows.

Hu Jiulang walked out slowly, and the figure in black stood at the edge of the formation. He held two cinnabar talismans between his fingertips and tossed them away.

The talisman unfolded in the air and turned into two red light patterns, sealing the left and right walls of the passage respectively, forcibly blocking the spread of the black mist of the illusion, and completely blocking the escape and mental spells that Koga Ninja relied on.

The illusion was blocked, stealth failed, and the ninjas instantly fell into a passive situation of head-on fighting.

"Take action!"
